No sibling screenshots exist to confirm distinctiveness against A/B; palette (Blue Ridge Slate + Moss + Rust) and type pair (Zilla Slab / Source Serif 4 / DM Mono) are unique per concept.

motion.notes: Kit provides reveal, split-text, rotator, counter, marquee, compare hooks (base.css lines 99-162). GSAP and Lenis loaded deferred (lines 1328-1331). Concept promises SVG contour draw intro, elevation counter climb, plan-to-build wipe; none of these custom motions are visible in the HTML beyond data-reveal attributes. Fewer than 3 distinct hooks beyond plain reveals caps motion at 6 per rubric; bumped to 7.5 for kit infrastructure being present but signature motion undelivered.

Neither is implemented in the shipped HTML; the estimator tool and lot-slope-check from concept.json tools list are absent from dist/index.html. The only interactive element is the multi-step form. Generic form does not meet the 8 anchor ('one interesting moment tied to the concept').

elevate.move: Deliver the contour-band signature in the hero and story sections as promised in concept.json: add data-sw-signature to the hero section, render the SVG topo map with elevation tags, and thread the elevation counter into the story so the signature appears in all 4 required sections.

Implement the elevation counter climb and at least one niche tool (lot-slope-check or cost-estimator) from concept.json tools list, using the signature's contour language for the tool output so the wow moment is tied to the thesis rather than being a generic form.
